why: owner 28 Nov: 1.2.2 draft with unified terms

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.2.2-beta (draft) for WoW Forever 1.60.1 (game build 71139)

Fixed (one word for one term)
- About 1000 rows of data and several addon lines now use one Persian word for one English term. Stun and stunned are both فلج everywhere (they were also مبهوت and گیج). Silence, pet, two-handed, mail, off-hand, wand, crossbow, tabard, threat and many item words were unified to the site glossary.

From the earlier 1.2.2 drafts
- Taint watcher for the blocked action buttons. Item tooltips of the weapon enchant button are left alone by the buff module. The copy buttons no longer call the game clipboard function. System lines reach the report again after a clear.

This build is for testing in game. Nothing of the game is written, and nothing runs in combat unless the combat option is turned on.
